verdicts.reason: Both lose the headline 'We help choosing the right smartphone', the URL and the HO SMART wordmark entirely, so neither carries any message. A puts an empty blue block at the top and a pale outline logo floating white-on-white below it, leaves a large dead middle and crops the photo strip off the left and bottom edges. B is the original banner shrunk into a thin strip across the middle, with a tiny, barely visible logo above it on white and about 75% of the canvas empty. That is a shrunk copy, not a rearrangement. A is marginally less bad because it at least spreads its elements across the portrait format.
